Walmart's net income rose about 2.9% from fiscal Q1 2025 to fiscal Q4 2025. I used net income attributable to Walmart, which is the usual "net income" figure.

- **Q1 FY2025 (quarter ended April 30, 2024):** Consolidated net income attributable to Walmart was $5,104 million.
- **Q4 FY2025 (quarter ended January 31, 2025):** I derived this figure rather than reading it from a filing. I took full-year attributable net income of about $19,436 million, which I recalled from memory and did not check in this search. I then subtracted the nine-month figure of $14,182 million from the Q3 10-Q. That gives about $5,254 million.
- **Change:** (5,254 − 5,104) / 5,104 ≈ +2.9%.

Consolidated net income, which includes noncontrolling interests, gives a slightly lower change. Q1 was $5,307 million. Q4 is about $5,425 million, derived from my recalled full-year figure of $20,157 million less the nine-month $14,732 million. That is roughly +2.2%.
